'''February 2001 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Joliet, Illinois on 17 February 2001. [[Steve Kuperman]] won it. It is known from Edmund Gray's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1747">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-joliet-2-17-01d1747/ joliet-2-17-01], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 19 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-joliet-2-17-01d1747/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Joliet, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]
